iespr7.description_en:
To all available contractors,
Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.
In particular, our scientists at [DESTINATION] have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.
For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
iespr7.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

拉亚利科学家们正努力解决再生技术失效的问题。目前，他们的工作因缺乏材料而受阻，他们认为这些物资可能对他们的实验至关重要。

特别是，我们在 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的科学家们因耗尽这些资源而不得不暂停工作。由于供应短缺，我们的常规供应商数月内无法供货，因此我们将为任何能协助补充这些物资的人提供丰厚报酬。

有关这些动物的更多信息，请参阅您日志中的《探险家的可采集物指南》。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

177sem9.description_en:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.
If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] and deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.
Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a 32 SCU load, and try not to get shot in the process. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.
Stows out.
177sem9.description_zh:
需要有人帮我们拿些货物。我们之前在一个老旧的哈索尔平台校准设施上进行秘密情报传递，但当地的帮派已经在那里扎根了，我们无法取回我们的东西。

如果你想动手的话，从 <EM4>[LOCATION] 的货运电梯</EM4>上拿走货物，然后送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION] 的货运电梯</EM4>上。

我听说这个地方混杂着各种人。拿回我们的东西可不容易，但这就是我们花钱付雇你的原因。

确保你有一艘能装下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU]</EM4> 货物的飞船，并尽量在过程中不要被打中。带个<EM4>手持式牵引光束</EM4>也是个聪明选择。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
We appreciate how hard you’ve been working for us recently, which is why we’d like to offer you this advanced contract. An important client of ours is waiting for delivery on multiple packages but the courier due to deliver them is no longer responding. The package trackers are showing that they’re at [LOCATION], meaning we have some time to recover the delivery.
PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 5x [ITEM1]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]
We cannot stress enough how important the success of this delivery is. Since we do not know what happened to the original courier, we strongly urge you to travel with several trustworthy combat pilots.
Needless to say, we’re offering a substantial payout for this one proportionate to the danger of the contract.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

地点：<EM4>[SYSTEM] </EM4>

条款*：
由于我们的采购渠道发生变化，舒宾星际目前正在寻求从该地区独立矿工处购买多种材料。虽然在贸易中心出售可能获得比完成我们的订单获得更具竞争力的价格，但许多矿工发现，加强与舒宾的关系是职业生涯中明智的长期投资。

[LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的 mobiGlas 日志中的<EM4>《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》</EM4>。如果你需要复习如何获取这些材料，也可以顺便阅读第一部分<EM4>《采矿基础 #1：基本概述》</EM4>。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如<EM4>[MULTITOOL]</EM4>。

等你准备好出售我们所需的材料，请将其存入位于 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

ph1ai9.description_en:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at [LOCATION]. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the [OBJECTS] there.
I need you and whatever crew you can muster on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any friendly ships that need a hand.
Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor 4 Council Scrip.
- Stows

有个小帮派一直像根刺扎在我们这儿，那帮混蛋刚在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 伏击了几个朋友。看样子他们正拼命想毁了那里的 <EM4>[OBJECTS]</EM4>。

我要你带上所有<EM4>你可以召集的船员</EM4>立刻赶去现场，阻止这些混蛋把一切都炸飞，还得护住那些需要帮忙的<EM4>友方飞船</EM4>。

这事办得漂亮的话，我就给主承包商 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证</EM4>。

- 斯托斯

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
